message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" They want earliest reference from historical record. We can answer: earliest references are in the New Testament (Gospels), but earliest external references are in Josephus (Antiquities 18.3) and Tacitus (Annals 15.44). Also maybe in the Roman sources like Pliny the Younger. But earliest is Josephus. So answer: Josephus, Antiquities of the Jews, 18.3, written around 93-94 CE.
